integration.plan: Resolve every accepted destination to community, county FIPS, state FIPS, and statewide identity context before consumer use.
Treat LP158 as protected governed baseline; LP159 creates source-selection policy only and requires a future patch milestone for record ingestion.
Keep address search authoritative and separate; use destination candidates only as POI results with explicit source provenance and address confidence.
Allow only quality-gated, non-sensitive, routable destinations with valid coordinates and county containment into Route Watch candidate planning.
Use destination names to improve awareness context, while suppressing sensitive infrastructure details unless consumer-safe wording is approved.
Build aliases, brand variants, misspellings, and category boosts from approved/conditional sources, with source isolation for ODbL and commercial terms.
